طَاعِمٌ Eating: and tasting. (S.) ―
-b2- And (tropical:) A man having a good state, or condition, in respect of food; as also ↓ طَعِمٌ ; (K, TA;) [each] a possessive epithet in this sense; on the authority of Sb. (TA.) ―
-b3- أَنَا طَاعِمٌ عَنْ طَعَامِكُمْ, thus in the A and K, but in the L غَيْرَ طعامكم, (TA,) means (tropical:) I am in no need of your food. (K, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
